data.description:
## 1. Technical Environment

- **code_version (this filing):** aaf96e90a41babee34faa70058dec7b0d51659ea
- **Affected file:** plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md (Phase A Step 2.5 Worktree Ancestry Gate)

## 2. Incident Overview

**Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

### Expected Behavior
Ancestry gate should not hard-stop investigation when the affected code is still present on HEAD with the buggy pattern intact. The gate rationale ('affected code may not exist here') does not apply if the orchestrator can verify the affected file/pattern is present on HEAD.

### Actual Behavior
Bug 4bf1-3198 was filed from a sprint-story branch (eb487f27, on branch 'story/e7f3-2b45-8d7d-4c68/1ef8-79c4-6195-4c98'). That commit is not an ancestor of main HEAD because the story branch has not merged. Phase A Step 2.5 fires `ANCESTOR_FAIL` and hard-stops the skill, even though:
- plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/prompts/cross-epic-scan.md exists on HEAD
- Line 35 still reads 'Batch into Groups of 20' (the exact buggy cap the ticket reports)

Hard-stopping here forces the user to manually override or re-queue, and creates friction whenever bugs are filed mid-sprint-story from worktrees forked off story branches.

## 3. Action History

User ran /dso:fix-bug 4bf1-3198. Ancestry check failed. User chose to override and file this meta-bug.

## 4. Skills and Workflows

- **Affected workflow step:** /dso:fix-bug Phase A Step 2.5 (Worktree Ancestry Gate)
- **Proposed mitigation:** Before hard-stopping on ANCESTOR_FAIL, parse `file_impact` (if present) or affected-file hints from the bug description and check whether those files exist on HEAD. If they do, demote the failure to a warning comment and continue. Only hard-stop if no affected files can be located on HEAD. Alternatively, exempt bugs filed with the CLI_user tag from the hard-stop (treat as user-acknowledged scope).
data.title: [fix-bug/ancestry-gate]: Bug filed from unmerged story branch -> ancestry gate hard-stops even when affected code is present on HEAD
